question: Should ClawHub consume `@openclaw/design-system` from a public immutable source, or should CI, deploys, and Dependabot receive explicit cross-repository access to the private SSH repository before this PR proceeds?
rationale: The current blocker is organization-level repository visibility or credential policy, so local code review cannot make the branch merge-safe by itself.

options.title: Make the dependency installable everywhere
options.body: Publish the design-system tag or grant narrowly scoped CI/deploy access, then rerun install, build, and preview gates before merge.

options.title: Keep the draft stack blocked
options.body: Leave this PR open as the design-system base until organization policy allows the dependency to be consumed safely.

options.title: Rework without the private package
options.body: Drop the package dependency and keep only local guidance if maintainers do not want ClawHub coupled to the private design-system repository yet.

recommendation.title: Make the dependency installable everywhere
recommendation.body: Publish the design-system tag or grant narrowly scoped CI/deploy access, then rerun install, build, and preview gates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the visible owner of the package/skill area and authored the current design-system install stack.
